shots.motion: A young woman climbs the outside wooden stairs of an old building at night in the rain, clothes on the lines sway
A middle-aged woman pours hot tea from a pan into two small glasses, steam rises
A hand sets an old folded newspaper down on a small table beside two glasses of tea, steam drifts
A young woman with wet eyes speaks, her lips trembling, a tear forms
A middle-aged woman freezes with a glass of tea halfway to her lips and slowly lowers it
A middle-aged woman sitting on a bed looks out of the window at distant city lights, a distant train passes
A middle-aged woman with tears in her eyes, a tear rolls down her cheek, she presses her lips together
A woman reaches up and lifts down an old round tin from the top of a steel cupboard
The lid lifts away from an old tin revealing a faded baby shawl and half a burnt ticket, light falls on them
A young hand slides an old ticket into place beside a half-burnt identical ticket on a table
Slow push in on two old tickets lined up edge to edge, light glints across them
A mother and daughter look at each other across a small table, the mother lips tremble
Slow push in on a paper calendar with the date 14 circled in red
A young woman squeezes her mother hand across a table and looks up with determination
Through a rainy window, lights of a passing train streak across the glass while two women sit at a table inside
